## Formats

| Format | Output | Document types |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mcanouil-typst` | PDF, through Typst | `report`, `article`, `memo`, `letter`, `invoice`, `workshop` |
| `mcanouil-html` | One HTML page, or a Quarto book | `report`, `article`, `memo`, `workshop` |
| `mcanouil-revealjs` | Reveal.js slides | presentation deck, `workshop` |

: The three formats and the document types that each one renders. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[24,30,46]"}

A `letter` or an `invoice` in HTML or Reveal.js stops the render with a message that names the type and `mcanouil-typst`.
Reveal.js reads `type` only for `workshop`.
Any other value, or no value, gives a presentation deck.

The extension has no project type.
For a website, use the [atelier](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-atelier) project type.

### Format defaults

Each format sets these Quarto options.
You can override each one in your own `format:` block.

| Format | Option | Value | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mcanouil-typst` | `pdf-standard` | `ua-1` | Every PDF is tagged for PDF/UA-1. See [Typst format](examples/typst-format.qmd#accessible-pdf). |
| `mcanouil-typst` | `date-format` | `long` | Dates show in full, in the order of the document language. |
| `mcanouil-typst` | `number-sections` | `true` | See [Heading numbers](examples/typst-format.qmd#heading-numbers). |
| `mcanouil-typst` | `crossref.appendix-delim` | `":"` | Appendix headings read "Appendix A: Title". |
| `mcanouil-typst` | `font-paths` | `fonts` | Typst uses the fonts that the extension ships. |
| `mcanouil-html` | `respect-user-color-scheme` | `true` | The page follows the light or dark setting of the reader. |
| `mcanouil-html` | `title-block-banner` | `true` | The title block is the banner landmark of the page. |
| `mcanouil-revealjs` | `width`, `height`, `margin` | `1280`, `720`, `0` | Slides are 16:9 and the motif reaches the slide edges. |
| `mcanouil-revealjs` | `slide-number` | `c/t` | The slide number shows as "n / total". |
| `mcanouil-revealjs` | `progress` | `true` | A thin gilded progress bar. |
| `mcanouil-revealjs` | `center-title-slide` | `false` | The title slide content starts at the top. |

: The Quarto options that each format sets. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[20,24,14,42]"}

The heading shift warning of Quarto is off in `mcanouil-typst` (`extensions: offset-headings: quarto-shift-warning: false`).
A document that starts at `##` still gets the shift, without the warning.

`toc` is off by default.
In `mcanouil-html`, set `toc: true` to show the contents.
In `mcanouil-typst`, the full report always has a main contents, and the other types have none.

## Options

All the options of the extension go under `extensions: mcanouil:`, in the front matter or in `_quarto.yml`.

```yaml
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    preset: gold
    type: report
    layout: full
```

### Preset and type

| Option | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `preset` | `gold`, `mono`, `quarto`, `terminal` | `gold` | Colours, fonts, style and motif for every format. See [Presets](examples/presets.qmd). |
| `type` | `report`, `article`, `memo`, `letter`, `invoice`, `workshop` | `report` | Document type. |
| `layout` | `compact`, `full` | `compact` | Layout of a `report`. The other types have one layout. |
| `kind` | `note`, `minutes`, `agenda`, `brief` | `note` | Kind of a `memo`. |
| `memo` | map | none | Banner fields of a memo. See [Memo](examples/memo.qmd). |
| `chapter-toc-depth` | number, 1 or more | `2` | Heading levels under a chapter that the chapter contents list. `1` lists the sections only. |
| `letter-standard` | `nf`, `din` | from `lang` | Geometry of a letter or an invoice. See [Letter and invoice](examples/letter-invoice.qmd). |

: Options for the preset and the document type. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[20,30,12,38]"}

An unknown preset, type, layout, kind or standard stops the render.
The message names the value and lists the values that you can use.

### Header and footer

`header` and `footer` each have three slots: `left`, `centre` and `right`.
`center` is an alias of `centre`.
Content in a slot is aligned to the left, centred, or aligned to the right.

```yaml
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    header:
      left: title
      right: chapter
    footer:
      centre: "Confidential"
      right: page
```

A slot holds text, or the name of one of these fields:

| Field | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `title` | Document title. |
| `subtitle` | Document subtitle. |
| `author` | Author names. With more than two authors, the first name and "et al.". |
| `date` | Document date. |
| `version` | The `version` key of the front matter. |
| `chapter` | Title of the chapter in force at the top of the page (Typst). |
| `page` | Page number as "n / total", or the slide number in a deck. |
| `speaker` | The authors and the `event`, joined by a middle dot. |
| `event` | The `event` option. |
| `session` | "Session n", from the `session` option. |

: The fields that a header or footer slot can show. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[20,80]"}

An empty string leaves the slot empty.
A slot that you do not set takes the default of the document type:

| Type | Header (left, centre, right) | Footer (left, centre, right) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `report` | title, empty, chapter | author, version, page |
| `article` | title, empty, empty | author, version, page |
| `memo` | empty, empty, empty | author, version, page |
| `letter` | empty, empty, empty | empty, empty, page |
| `invoice` | empty, empty, empty | empty, empty, page |
| `workshop` | empty, empty, empty | event, session, page |
| deck | not used | speaker, title, page |

: The default slots of each document type. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[16,42,42]"}

The header is used in Typst only.
The footer is used in Typst, in the HTML page footer, and in Reveal.js.
In a deck, only `page` in the right slot shows the slide number.
With any other value there, the slide number is off and the render gives a warning.
A Quarto `footer` in a deck replaces the three slots.
An unknown slot name, or both `centre` and `center` in one part, stops the render.

### Decks and workshops

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `event` | text | Event of a deck or a workshop, for example `useR! 2026 · Warwick`. It shows above the title and in the `speaker` and `event` fields. |
| `speakers` | list of `photo` and `alt` | Speaker photos on the title slide, one entry per author, in the order of the authors. A photo without `alt` gives a warning. |
| `closing` | `true`, or a map of `title`, `links` and `licence` | Closing slide of a deck. Links show as plain text, so they read in a PDF export too. |
| `session` | map of `number` and `total` | Session of a workshop. The kicker shows "Session 2 of 7" and exercises are numbered 2.1, 2.2. |
| `duration` | text | Duration of a workshop session, for example `90 min`, shown beside the date. |
| `solutions` | `end`, `inline`, `hide` | Place of the solutions in the PDF handout of a workshop. Default `end`. |

: Options for decks and workshops. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[16,26,58]"}

See [Reveal.js format](examples/revealjs-format.qmd) and [Workshop](examples/workshop.qmd).

## Front matter

The extension also reads these Quarto and Pandoc keys.

| Key | Used by | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title`, `subtitle`, `date` | all | Title block. A Typst document needs a `title`, which is also the PDF title. A letter without a `title` uses its `subject`. An invoice without a `title` uses "Invoice" and its number. Any other type without a `title` stops the render. |
| `author`, `affiliations` | all | Authors, as Quarto normalises them. See [Authors](examples/report-article.qmd#authors). |
| `abstract`, `keywords` | report, article | Abstract box and keywords. |
| `kicker` | report, article | Small line above the title. A report shows "Report" when it is not set. |
| `version` | all | `version` field of the slots. |
| `license`, `copyright` | report | Licence and copyright on the closing page of a full report. |
| `brand-mode` | Typst, Reveal.js | `dark` gives a dark PDF or a dark deck. |
| `lang` | all | Labels and date order. See [Labels and dates](examples/typst-format.qmd#labels-and-dates). |
| `sender`, `address`, `place`, `reference`, `your-reference`, `subject`, `opening`, `closing`, `signature-image`, `cc`, `encl`, `ps` | letter | Letter fields. |
| `sender`, `recipient`, `invoice`, `bank` | invoice | Invoice data. |

: The front matter keys that the extension reads. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[30,18,52]"}

## Classes and attributes

| Class | Where | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `.references` | level 1 heading | The references section. It is not numbered and moves to the end, before the appendices. |
| `.appendix` | level 1 heading | An appendix, lettered A, B. It moves to the end of a single document. |
| `.supplementary` | level 1 heading | A supplementary section, numbered S1, S2. It moves to the end of a single document. |
| `.objectives`, `.prerequisites`, `.checkpoint` | div, workshop | Labelled workshop blocks. |
| `.exercise` | div, workshop | Numbered exercise, with optional `duration` and `format` attributes. |
| `.solution` | div inside `.exercise`, workshop | Solution of the exercise. |
| `.dark` | slide heading, deck | The slide uses the dark tokens of the preset. |

: The classes that the extension reads. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[24,26,50]"}

See [Special sections](examples/special-sections.qmd) and [Workshop](examples/workshop.qmd).

## Embedded tools {#embedded-tools}

The extension embeds these tools, each pinned at a release.
The formats run them in a fixed order.

::: {.callout-important}

Do not list an embedded tool again in your own `filters:`.
The format already runs it.
If your project has no copy of the tool, Quarto stops with an error.

:::

A project can keep its own copy of an embedded tool, for example to work on that tool.
When the copy is under `_extensions/`, with any owner such as `_extensions/local/veil/`, and you name it in your own `filters:`, the embedded filters of that tool do not run.
Only your copy runs.
If you do not name your copy, the embedded filters run as usual.
For Typst, your copy of code-window must be version 1.10.0 or later, because the presets set its `fill` and `stroke` theme keys.

Some tools also give a Reveal.js plugin or a shortcode, and Quarto loads these parts in a different way:

- Reveal.js plugins: the `mcanouil-revealjs` format always loads the embedded plugins of veil, tabset, and codefrag.
  When you name your copy in `revealjs-plugins:`, the deck also loads the plugin files of your copy, after the embedded files.
  A file of your copy replaces an embedded file with the same name.
  For veil and codefrag, name your copy in `filters:` and in `revealjs-plugins:`.
- Shortcodes: Quarto loads the shortcodes of each extension in your project, also when you do not name it.
  The shortcode of your copy of iconify always replaces the embedded shortcode, so name your copy in `filters:` too.

The render shows a warning that starts with `[embedded]` in two cases.
The first case is a deck that names your copy of veil or codefrag in only one of `filters:` and `revealjs-plugins:`.
The second case is a project that has a copy of iconify that `filters:` does not name.

| Tool | Version | Formats | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [code-window](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-code-window) | 1.10.1 | all | on |
| [div-reuse](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-div-reuse) | 1.5.1 | all | on |
| [gitlink](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-gitlink) | 1.14.0 | all | on, off in letters and invoices |
| [highlight-text](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-highlight-text) | 3.0.0 | all | on |
| [iconify](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-iconify) | 4.2.2 | all | on |
| [offset-headings](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-offset-headings) | 0.5.1 | all | on |
| [prism](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-prism) | 0.6.0 | all | on |
| [toc-depth](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-toc-depth) | 0.7.1 | all | on |
| [typst-extras](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-typst-extras) | 0.1.2 | Typst | on |
| [typst-render](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-typst-render) | 0.22.7 | all | on |
| [veil](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-veil) | 0.4.0 | all | on |
| [mobile-toc](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-mobile-toc) | 0.2.5 | HTML | on |
| [revealjs-cascade](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-revealjs-cascade) | 2.1.1 | Reveal.js | on |
| [revealjs-codefrag](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-revealjs-codefrag) | 1.2.1 | Reveal.js | on |
| [revealjs-tabset](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-revealjs-tabset) | 1.5.0 | Reveal.js | on |
| [preview-colour](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-preview-colour) | 2.1.1 | all | opt-in |
| [collapse-output](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-collapse-output) | 1.6.1 | HTML, Reveal.js | opt-in |
| [remember](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-remember) | 2.1.0 | HTML, Reveal.js | opt-in |

: The embedded tools, their versions, the formats that run them, and whether they are on by default. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[30,12,26,32]"}

A tool that is on does nothing until you use its syntax, apart from code-window, which decorates every code block.
Each tool reads its own options under `extensions: <tool>:`.
For example, `extensions: gitlink: enabled: true` turns gitlink back on in a letter.

To turn on an opt-in tool, set its option:

```yaml
extensions:
  preview-colour:
    code: true
  collapse-output:
    collapse-all-outputs: true
  remember:
    enabled: true
```

collapse-output also works per cell, with the `output-fold` attribute.

### typst-extras {#typst-extras}

typst-extras adds these features to `mcanouil-typst`, under `extensions: typst-extras:`:

- `list-of`: lists of figures, tables and listings at the start of the body.
- `watermark`: a text or an image on every page, for example `watermark: DRAFT`.
- `sections`: `appendix-delimiter` (default `.`, as in Figure A.1) and `supplementary-prefix` (default `S`, as in Figure S1).
- Numbering of `.appendix` and `.supplementary` sections, with their floats, equations and cross-references.
- Chapter numbering of floats with Quarto's `crossref.chapters: true`.
- Alt text for maths: an `alt` attribute on a span or a div that holds one formula.

```yaml
extensions:
  typst-extras:
    list-of: [fig, tbl]
    watermark: DRAFT
    sections:
      supplementary-prefix: "S"
```

```markdown
[$E = mc^2$]{alt="E equals m c squared"}
```

See [Special sections](examples/special-sections.qmd) and the [known limitations](limitations.qmd).
